description: Resonant comb filter, a series of evenly spaced notches tuned by a 1V/octave input, which rings when the feedback is high

params.text: Offsets the V/OCT input, which sets the frequency of the comb, and with nothing patched to V/OCT the reference is 0V
Sets the type of comb, which gives a different character for a given pitch and input signal
Sets how much of the output is fed back into the filter, and high feedback makes the comb resonate until it rings
Attenuates and inverts the COMB input before it is added to the COMB knob
Attenuates and inverts the FEEDBACK input before it is added to the FEEDBACK knob

inputs.text: Sets the frequency of the comb, 1V per octave
The left channel of the audio input
A control voltage added to the COMB setting, scaled by the COMB attenuverter
A control voltage added to the FEEDBACK setting, scaled by the FEEDBACK attenuverter
The right channel of the audio input

outputs.text: The left channel of the filtered signal
The right channel of the filtered signal
